seam_bypass.instructions: Judging only the supplied changed-file list, diff hunks, and architecture excerpt: does the diff make a component produce or render output outside its architectural seam (e.g. load-file output outside the composer -> serializer -> emitter seam, fat writers bypassing LoadFileEmitter, production set packing outside ProductionSetOrchestrator, post-validation coupled directly to writers rather than ValidationOrchestrator, or CLI module leaks bypassing ICliModule)? The EDRM-XML carve-out (XmlLoadFileWriter) is the only sanctioned load-file exception.

criteria.true: The diff bypasses an architectural seam (load file, production set orchestrator, validation orchestrator, or CLI module boundaries)
criteria.false: The diff stays within designated architectural seams (or only touches the sanctioned EDRM-XML carve-out)

diagram_stale.instructions: Judging only the supplied changed-file list, diff hunks, and architecture excerpt: does the diff change component structure or data flow such that the docs/architecture.md diagrams or invariants are now inaccurate (stale), without the diff itself updating docs/architecture.md?

criteria.true: Structure changed and docs/architecture.md was not updated in the same diff
criteria.false: No structural change, or docs/architecture.md was updated in the same diff
